He has previously played for the [[Los Angeles Lakers]] of the [[NBA]] and the [[South Bay Lakers]] of the [[NBA G League]].{{cite web|title=Armel Traore, Basketball Player|url=https://www.proballers.com/basketball/player/180210/armel-traore|website=Proballers.com|access-date=29 June 2024}} ==Professional career== ===AS Monaco / ALM Évreux (2021–2022)=== After beginning his career with [[Centre Fédéral de Basket-ball|CFBB]], Traoré signed with [[AS Monaco Basket|AS Monaco]] of the [[LNB Élite|LNB Pro A]] on 7 July 2021.{{cite web|title=Monaco add young talent Armel Traore|url=https://basketnews.com/news-153522-monaco-add-young-talent-armel-traore.html|website=BasketNews.com|date=7 July 2021|access-date=23 July 2024}} In early 2022, Traoré was loaned to [[ALM Évreux Basket|ALM Évreux]] of the [[LNB Pro B]].{{cite web|title=ARMEL TRAORÉ PRÊTÉ À EVREUX|url=https://asmonaco.basketball/news/show.php?ID=35051|website=ASMonaco.basketball|access-date=23 July 2024|language=French}} ===Metropolitans 92 (2022–2023)=== On 26 July 2022, Traoré signed with [[Metropolitans 92]] of the [[LNB Élite|LNB Pro A]].{{cite web|title=Armel Traoré arrive aux Metropolitans 92 pour deux saisons !|url=https://www.metropolitans92.com/fr/actualites/2022-07-26/armel-traore-arrive-aux-metropolitans-92-pour-deux-saisons|website=Metropolitans92.com|date=26 July 2022|access-date=23 July 2024|language=French}} ===ADA Blois (2023–2024)=== On 23 June 2023, Traoré signed with [[ADA Blois Basket 41|ADA Blois]] of the [[LNB Élite|LNB Pro A]]{{cite web|title=ARMEL TRAORÉ EST BLÉSOIS !|url=https://ada-basket.com/2023/06/armel-traore-blesois/|website=ADA-Blois.com|date=26 July 2022|access-date=23 July 2024|language=French}} where he averaged 10.8 points, 7.3 rebounds and 1.5 assists in 25.5 minutes after playing in 33 matches.{{cite web|title=Lakers Sign Blake Hinson and Armel Traore to Two-Way Contracts|url=https://www.nba.com/lakers/news/lakers-sign-blake-hinson-and-armel-traore-to-two-way-contracts-070524|website=NBA.com|date=5 July 2024|access-date=5 July 2024}} ===Los Angeles / South Bay Lakers (2024–2025)=== After going undrafted in the [[2024 NBA draft]], Traoré signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Los Angeles Lakers]] on 5 July 2024.{{Cite web |last=Stinar |first=Ben |date=August 18, 2024 |title=Los Angeles Lakers Player Will Be First Player In Franchise History To Wear No. 94 |url=https://www.si.com/fannation/nba/fastbreak/los-angeles-lakers-player-will-be-first-player-in-franchise-history-to-wear-no-94-traore |access-date=August 20, 2024 |website=SI.com}} In nine appearances for Los Angeles, Traoré averaged 1.6 points, 1.7 rebounds, and 0.1 assists. He was waived by the Lakers on 5 February 2025.{{Cite web |date=2025-02-08 |title=Los Angeles Lakers Release Player Before Pacers Game
